{{Weapon infobox | type = Greatsword | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot= Superior Sigil of Leeching | bound = account use | skin = Eternity (skin); Sunrise (skin); Twilight (skin); Dawn (skin); Khrysaor, the Golden Sword (skin); Dawn Experiment (skin); Dusk (skin); Naegling (skin); Dusk Experiment (skin) | gallery1 = Eternity (day).jpg | gallery1-text = During the day. | gallery2 = Eternity (night).jpg | gallery2-text = During the night. | gallery3 = Eternity footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Eternity footfalls. | id = 30689 }} [[Eternity]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] greatsword crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]] and serves as a combination of the two legendary greatswords, [[Sunrise]] and [[Twilight]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Although the [[Six Human Gods|gods]] have abandoned [[Tyria]], their gifts remain. The oceans and land. The verdant forests, the limitless cosmos beyond—the ultimate love letter to the living, but also a solemn good-bye.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipes === {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Sunrise | ingredient2 = 1 Twilight | ingredient3 = 5 Pile of Crystalline Dust | ingredient4 = 10 Philosopher's Stone }} {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Memory of Sunrise | ingredient2 = 1 Memory of Twilight | ingredient3 = 5 Pile of Crystalline Dust | ingredient4 = 10 Philosopher's Stone }} == Graphics == [[Eternity]] is a greatsword whose appearance switches between [[Sunrise]] and [[Twilight]] depending on the [[Day and night#Day-night cycle|time of day]]. Additionally, the pommel of Eternity consists of a multicolored gem which emanates a bright glow. ;Day/night cycle: * Day: Eternity appears as Sunrise and shares all of its graphics excluding footfalls. In addition, the blade emanates a sky-colored smoke/flame. * Night: Eternity appears as Twilight and shares all of its graphics excluding footfalls. In addition, the blade emanates a dark themed smoke/flame. ;Aura * The user's body is surrounded by blue light/darkness that radiates much like smoke or flames. * Small blue/dark orbs rise from the user's body. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a burst of light/darkness emanates from the user's body. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind painterly footprints that act as a window into a starry sky. Orange/purple orbs also rise from the footprints depending on the time of day. ;Skill effects * Ranged skills will throw rotating crossed [[Sunrise]] and [[Twilight]] instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{Skill icon|Whirling Wrath}} and {{Skill icon|Binding Blade}}. *** {{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{Skill icon|Spear of Justice}}. ** {{w}} [[Warrior]]: {{Skill icon|Bladetrail}} and {{Skill icon|Throw Rock}} (downed skill). ** {{r}} [[Ranger]]: {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} (downed skill) . *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as {{Skill icon|Narcotic Spores}}. ** {{m}} [[Mesmer]]: {{Skill icon|Mirror Blade}} and {{Skill icon|Phantasmal Berserker}}. ** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Sap}} (downed skill). *** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{Skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}. ** {{n}} [[Necromancer]]: *** {{harbinger}} [[Harbinger Shroud]]: {{Skill icon|Tainted Bolts}} and {{Skill icon|Dark Barrage}}. *** {{ritualist}} [[Ritualist]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Blast}} === Gallery === File:Eternity stowed day.jpg|Stowed during the day. following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary}} == Notes == * All accounts that add Eternity to their [[Legendary Armory]] will also automatically unlock [[Sunrise]] and [[Twilight]] if they don't already have them, both to the armory and as skins. This includes accounts that had a bound Eternity prior to the [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021 update]].[https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/97798-legendary-armory-follow-up-clarifications/ Official GW2 Forums | Legendary Armory: Follow up clarifications] * Crafting Eternity using Sunrise and Twilight will unlock those skins on your account even if you don't bind the Eternity. * Eternity created from [[Memory of Sunrise]] and/or [[Memory of Twilight]] will be automatically bound to your Legendary Armory and can't be sold. Even when in legendary armory, the skin itself will be unlocked only after equiping Eternity itself. {{anomaly|Creating Eternity in this manner will add the weapon to your Legendary Armory but not automatically unlock the skin. You need to specifically equip Eternity on a character once to unlock the skin for your Wardrobe.}} == Trivia == * The [[Risen High Wizard]] protecting the gates of Arah in the [[Gates of Arah]] meta event can be seen wielding Eternity. * The statue behind the [[Wall of Champions]] in the [[Heart of the Mists]] is wielding Eternity. * [[Zommoros]] can be seen dual-wielding two Eternity, one in night form and the other in day form, while trapped inside [[Qadim's Lamp]]. == References == {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[Category:Legendary weapons]] [[de:Ewigkeit]] [[es:Eternidad]] [[fr:Eternité]]
